subject: Orion Labs — Vendor onboarding & PO format
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <mchen@orionlabs.com>; Orion Labs Procurement <po-ops@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Orion Labs — Vendor onboarding & PO format

Hi Maya / Orion procurement team,

Welcome — glad to kick off the vendor onboarding for Orion Labs. We need to get a few items squared away so our procurement and finance teams can issue POs and pay invoices without delay. Could you confirm the items below and return the vendor intake package where indicated?

Quick checklist we need from you:
- Do you require Redwood to issue a formal PO for all invoices? (yes/no)
- If yes, do you prefer: a single subscription line per invoice, or detailed line items per feature/SKU?
- Billing contact and billing email for invoices (we typically route to billing@redwood.com but will add your preferred mailbox)
- Tax / W-9 (or equivalent) and remit-to address
- If you use a vendor portal, please share the URL and instructions for invoice submission
- Any PO or invoice references you require to be present on the PDF (e.g., PO number, cost center, project code)

Please attach a completed vendor intake form and W-9 (or local tax doc). I attached our onboarding checklist and PO template for reference — if you prefer a different invoice layout we can review, but we do require a visible PO number on the invoice for automated processing.

Target timeline: once we have completed vendor setup (W-9 + intake form + banking info), Finance typically issues a first PO within 3–5 business days. If you need expedited processing, flag it here and loop in the account exec.

Questions? reply-all and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor-onboarding-checklist.docx (docx), redwood_po_template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Maya Chen <mchen@orionlabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Orion Labs Procurement <po-ops@orionlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orion Labs — Vendor onboarding & PO format

Hi Hannah,

Thanks — happy to get this moving. Quick answers up front:
- Yes, we require a PO number on the invoice.
- Our preference is to receive one invoice with grouped line items per subscription type (monthly license / per-seat / add-ons). We can provide detailed line-item breakdowns in the PDF if Redwood needs them separate for cost centers.
- Billing contact: Maya Chen, billing@orionlabs.com (primary). Remit: Orion Labs, 520 Atlas Ave, Suite 300, Palo Alto, CA 94301.
- Attached: completed vendor intake form and our W-9.
- We have a vendor portal for larger customers; for Redwood, email submission to billing@orionlabs.com is fine — portal details can be shared later if needed.

We reviewed your PO template and it looks good. A couple of asks: please include the PO number in the invoice filename (e.g., PO-12345-invoice.pdf) and include a short description per line item (2–4 words).

Attaching: orion_vendor_intake_form.pdf, orion_w9.pdf

We should be able to complete onboarding by EOD tomorrow and ready for a PO issuance on your side. Let me know if you want a quick 15-min call to align.

Best,
Maya Chen
Head of Procurement Operations
Orion Labs

Attachments: orion_vendor_intake_form.pdf (pdf), orion_w9.pdf (pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Maya Chen <mchen@orionlabs.com>; Orion Labs Procurement <po-ops@orionlabs.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 08:24:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orion Labs — Vendor onboarding & PO format

Thanks Maya — this is exactly what we need. A few procurement-side clarifications to ensure our AP system ingests invoices cleanly:

1) PO placement and filename
- Please place the PO number in the top-right of the invoice PDF and use the filename pattern you suggested (PO-####-invoice.pdf).

2) Line items and descriptions
- For subscription invoices we prefer grouped lines (one line per subscription product) with an additional description field that contains a short note (e.g., "Platform subscription - prod team").
- For professional services or one-time fees, please include unit price, quantity, and the unit-of-measure (hours / license).

3) Remit and tax
- We received your W-9 and remit address — thanks. AP will confirm the vendor tax ID once your intake form is ingested.

4) Expedite and approvals
- Standard PO issuance: 3–5 business days after completed intake.
- Expedited (same-day) possible with Finance approval for values under $25k — tag "expedite" in your email and include a brief justification.

I'll attach our PO template (redwood_po_template.xlsx) and the onboarding checklist for your records. Vivek / Finance, can you confirm the standard Net terms and any exceptions for new vendors?

Thanks,
Hannah
Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_po_template.xlsx (xlsx), vendor-onboarding-checklist.docx (docx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Chen <mchen@orionlabs.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 11:46:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Orion Labs — Vendor onboarding & PO format

Hi all,

Confirming Finance-side details:
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 from invoice receipt.
- First PO issuance after intake completion typically takes 3 business days; we'll aim for 1–2 days for repeatable SaaS subscriptions once the vendor is in the system.
- For vendor setups above $250k ARR or requiring credit review, expect additional approvals (3–7 business days).
- To request expedited PO issuance: email procure-expedite@redwood.com with the vendor name, deal value, and business justification. CC Hannah. Approvals routed to the Finance Director.

Doc/links: Redwood PO template (shared): https://redwood-corp.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/Onboarding-Templates/redwood_po_template

One operational note: invoices missing a PO number will be routed to a manual queue and can take 10–15 business days to process — please ensure PO present on the PDF and in the filename.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Chen <mchen@orionlabs.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Orion Labs — Vendor onboarding & PO format

Thanks — received the template and notes. We will:
- Return the signed vendor intake + tax forms today.
- Submit invoices with PO in the filename and top-right of PDF.
- For the first invoice can we send a partial invoice (50%) for onboarding professional services, with the remainder on completion? If that’s allowed, we’ll mark each invoice with the milestone and PO number.

If partial invoicing is acceptable, please confirm and we’ll include milestone descriptions in line items.

Best,
Maya
Orion Labs Procurement
